verdict.rationale: Ollama's homepage claims "dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when you are running several agents at once," which matches the story almost word for word. The pricing page adds that users can run multiple models concurrently. Both are short marketing lines, apparently tied to the cloud plans, with no technical docs or benchmarks behind them. Missing for 10: documentation of how capacity is reserved or what limits apply per tier, concurrency throughput benchmarks, independent or hands-on confirmation that throughput stays steady under concurrent agent load.
